# Chintan Savaliya — Web Designer & Developer

> Chintan Savaliya is a web designer and developer with 7+ years of experience building high-performance marketing sites for SaaS startups, design agencies, and VC-backed companies. He specializes in Webflow and Framer development, GSAP animations, CMS architecture, and AI search optimization (AEO/GEO). Based in India, working with clients worldwide. He has shipped 50+ websites and maintains a 5-star review record across 9 client engagements.

## About

Chintan builds websites that convert — combining design sensibility with technical execution. He works with early-stage startups, VC-backed companies, and design agencies as both a direct client partner and a white-label development resource. His background spans web design, Webflow and Framer development, GSAP animations, CMS architecture, programmatic SEO, and AI search optimization.

## Services

- **Web Design** — Figma-first, conversion-focused design for marketing sites and landing pages. URL: https://chintan.design/services

- **Webflow Development** — Custom Webflow sites from Figma designs, with CMS setup, SEO foundations, and animation polish. URL: https://chintan.design/services/webflow-development

- **Framer Development** — Custom Framer component development, interactive animations, and CMS-powered content. URL: https://chintan.design/services/framer-development

- **WordPress to Webflow Migration** — Full migration service including content migration, 301 redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and DNS cutover support. URL: https://chintan.design/services/wordpress-to-webflow

- **GSAP Web Animations** — Scroll-driven animations, page transitions, hover micro-interactions, and SVG path animations built with GSAP and ScrollTrigger. URL: https://chintan.design/services/gsap-animations

- **CMS Architecture & Strategy** — CMS schema design, collection planning, editor experience optimization, and content governance documentation. URL: https://chintan.design/services/cms-architecture

- **AEO / GEO (AI Search Optimization)** — Optimize sites for visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Claude. Includes structured data, citability optimization, and llms.txt implementation.

- **Programmatic SEO** — Scale organic growth with template-driven page generation, internal linking automation, and thin content safeguards.
